evidence.quote:
Gemini’s January 2025 cutoff removes only 12 of
120 Vanilla pairs, and filtered accuracy changes by
less than two points.

practical_problems.note: knowledge-cutoff contamination filter measured on the no-retrieval condition; accuracy also tracked across simulated-date horizons

evidence.quote:
KER improves from SE Graph
to Near-Resolution across models, indicating that
reasoning quality is gated by temporal evidence
access.

practical_problems.note: evidence and hindsight-graph alignment scored alongside outcome accuracy, with human-annotated graph review

summary: A resolved-question forecasting benchmark with a simulated-date evidence gateway and hindsight-graph scoring; the evaluation measures parametric leakage, temporal-evidence access and evidence alignment rather than improving a method.
